objective.jobToBeDone: Quickly scan all tasks assigned to me today, spot overdue items at a glance, and open any task to review its full details before starting work.
objective.primaryDecision: Which task should I work on next — select a task from the list to view its details.
objective.usageFrequency: Daily / continuous — field worker opens this screen at the start of each shift and returns throughout the day to check task status.

criticalActions.action: Browse assigned tasks filtered by status
criticalActions.presentation: master-detail — scrollable card list on primary surface with status filter chip bar folded into the list header

criticalActions.action: Select a task to view full details
criticalActions.presentation: master-detail — tapping a card loads the detail panel (or bottom sheet on mobile) without leaving the list

informationHierarchy: 1. Task list — title, status badge, due date, overdue highlight, project name
2. Status filter control — chip/tab bar to narrow by assigned / inProgress / completed / cancelled
3. Task detail panel — full description, due date, project context, status, completedAt / cancelledAt / cancellationReason when relevant
objective.successCriteria: A field worker can open the app, immediately see their tasks sorted by urgency (overdue first), filter to in-progress items in one tap, and read full task details without navigating away from the list.
antiPatterns: Separate full-page form for task detail
Manual input of assignedWorkerId or workTaskId — both are context-derived
Free <select> over all status enum values instead of filter chips
Desktop-style wide table — this is a mobile-first screen
Showing system timestamps (createdAt, updatedAt) as primary information
